prompt: give me all the social media groups that were discovered to be ran by the Russia IRA
judge_reasoning:
CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST:
1) Provide specific named social media groups/accounts allegedly run by the Russia/Internet Research Agency (IRA). (relevance+specificity)
2) Address “all” (or at least clearly acknowledge non-exhaustiveness). (completeness)
3) Stay aligned to IRA-operated groups (avoid generic “Russian interference” not IRA-specific).

Perception scan: N=4 markers. [1] first 5 words: “The Internet Research Agency (IRA)”; [2] “The term "Russia IRA" is often”; [3] “The Russian Internet Research Agency (IRA),”; [4] “The term "Russia IRA" is not”.
DIRECT/ADJACENT/OFF-TOPIC: [1] DIRECT (lists IRA-run groups/accounts); [2] ADJACENT/OFF-TOPIC (discusses broader disinformation and non-IRA entities, not specific “IRA-run groups”); [3] DIRECT (lists IRA-associated groups); [4] ADJACENT (general Russian interference; only loosely connects to IRA).
Key quality differences: Candidate 4 includes a likely verified falsehood (“company established in 2015”) and is mostly generic. Candidate 3 has heavy duplication within its list (20 items, ~15 unique; ~25% duplicates), reducing quality, though it’s still IRA-focused. Between 1 and 3, both are specific, but 1 is less duplicate/padded and is more consistently IRA-labeled; neither can be fully verified as exhaustive, so “all” is only partially satisfied.
